issue: Missing Axis 1 (provenance) label. The book's stated convention (Preface, book p. xi) requires every load-bearing quantitative claim to carry 'Axes 1 and 2 as an inline pair (e.g. [1P][DERIVED])'. This MLA reduction calculation is derived from DeepSeek first-party model geometry (n_h=128, d_h=128, d_c=512, d_h^R=64) but carries only Axis 2 [DERIVED] with no Axis 1 provenance tag (should be [1P][DERIVED]).
fix_instruction: Change '[DERIVED]' to '[1P][DERIVED]' in the Bytes/token cell of the Reduced-width per-token row of the §1.1.4 taxonomy table.

evidence: Book p. 89, §5.3(a): "and the quality claim itself is the §5.3(a)/§7 item still to validate on the target corpus"
issue: Malformed cross-reference: bare '§7' violates the book's own convention (Preface, book p. xiv: 'Section cross-references use the § chapter.section form: a bare § N.M refers to chapter N, section M'). '§7' lacks a section number. Contextually the author likely meant §5.7 (Ch. 5, 'What We Still Don't Know') or simply 'Ch. 7' — but as written, '§7' does not resolve to any defined target.
fix_instruction: Replace '§7' with either '§5.7' (if referring to Ch. 5 §7 'What We Still Don't Know') or 'Ch. 7' (if referring to Chapter 7 generally), depending on the intended target.

issue: List of Figures entry for Fig 7.3 cites page 129, but the caption text is on book p. 128. evidence: Book p. 39, §3.3.3: "The compute savings are straightforward: if only na = 12.8B of nt = 47B total parameters are active per token, the FLOP count drops by the active fraction relative to a same-size dense model."
issue: Arithmetically incorrect phrasing: 'drops by the active fraction' means subtracting the active fraction (27%), yielding 73% of original FLOPs — which is wrong. The actual result is that FLOPs drop TO 27% of a same-size dense model (12.8/47 ≈ 27%), i.e., a 73% reduction. 'By' and 'to' yield different numbers: by 27% gives 0.73×, to 27% gives 0.27×. The intended meaning is 'to.'
fix_instruction: Change 'drops by the active fraction' to 'drops to the active fraction' (or equivalently, 'is reduced to 27% of the same-size dense model's FLOP count').

evidence: Book p. 8, Fig 1.1 caption: "[ILLUSTRATIVE conceptual]"; also Fig 1.2 (p. 11): "[ILLUSTRATIVE conceptual]"; Fig 2.1 (p. 16): "[ILLUSTRATIVE conceptual]"; Fig 4.1 (p. 80): "[ILLUSTRATIVE conceptual]"; Fig 5.1 (p. 100/99): "[ILLUSTRATIVE conceptual]"; Fig 6.1 (p. 103): "[ILLUSTRATIVE conceptual]"; Fig 8.1 (p. 147): "[ILLUSTRATIVE conceptual]".
issue: Recurrence of label-pair format violation: the Preface (book p. xi) states 'A label pair always takes one item from each of the first two axes… the two tags are set with no space between them.' Figures labeled '[ILLUSTRATIVE conceptual]' provide only Axis 1 ([ILLUSTRATIVE]) with 'conceptual' as descriptive text inside the same bracket — no valid Axis 2 epistemic status ([FACT]/[DERIVED]/[ASSUMPTION]/[HYPOTHESIS]/[UNRESOLVED]) is present. This affects at least 7 figures across Chapters 1–8. By contrast, figures that do carry proper pairs (e.g., Fig 7.5 '[ILLUSTRATIVE][DERIVED]', Fig 7.7 '[ILLUSTRATIVE][DERIVED]') follow the convention correctly.
fix_instruction: For each conceptual figure, add a valid Axis 2 label as a separate adjacent tag, e.g. '[ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION] conceptual' — or add an explicit exception in the Preface's label rule stating that purely conceptual figures with no load-bearing quantitative claims may carry Axis 1 alone.
